Languages: Python, SQL.
Platform: Linux administration, Git.
Services: REST API design, unit testing, CI pipelines.

percentage. If it falls below 78 percent, warn me and name that cutoff, and
do not evaluate the nice-to-have requirements at all.

response.text:
**Mandatory match: 70% (7 of 10).**

That is below the **78 percent** cutoff. Nice-to-have requirements were not evaluated.
